name: Bernard
backstory: Bernard is the Construct guardian of the Arcane Tower in the Underdark. Created by the tower's owner, Lenore De Hurst, Bernard was designed for both protection and companionship.
relationships: 4x Animated Armour (on Explorer and Balanced difficulty)
6x Animated Armour (on Tactician and Honour difficulty)
